Trump Tower Jeddah

Saudi Arabia

  • Property Type Seafront Residences
  • Unit Type 1, 2, 3, 4 Bedroom Apartments & 3, 4 Bedroom Penthouses
  • Location Jeddah Corniche, Saudi Arabia
  • Completion Date December 2029
  • Number of Floors 47
  • Area (sqm)70 to 365

A Landmark on the Corniche

Perched up high, Trump Tower Jeddah is one of the tallest high-rises on the Corniche, overlooking the Red Sea. Residents enjoy a private club, spa, and concierge services.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is Trump Tower Jeddah?

Trump Tower Jeddah is a 47-floor Trump-branded seafront residential tower on the Jeddah Corniche developed by DarGlobal.

When will Trump Tower Jeddah be completed?

Completion is scheduled for December 2029 according to the project page.
